title: Azuremyst Isle
body: Azuremyst Isle is the southern of two misty isles off the northern coast of Kalimdor, long left wild by the night elves and home for centuries to furbolgs. Then the sky caught fire. The Exodar, the dimensional ship the draenei had seized from Tempest Keep, came down crippled on its western side, and the survivors made the largest piece of its hull their new home. The crash scattered irradiated crystals across the land, poisoning lakes and maddening beasts, while naga, goblins and blood elves prowl the island.

parts.body: A letter taken from a traitor showed who stood behind the plotting: Kael'thas Sunstrider, who called the Exodar his own vessel and ordered a full assault to take it back. An eredar agent had already told him where it lay.

title: Ammen Vale
body: Ammen Vale, a hill-sheltered island on the eastern side of Azuremyst, took one section of the Exodar when the ship broke apart. Those who woke from suspension among its wreckage found smoking debris, escape pods and the red glow of irradiated crystals, and many had died. A fallen power crystal has poisoned Silverline Lake, the owlkin of Nestlewood have turned violent, and reports of strange activity on Shadow Ridge to the southwest trouble the survivors.

parts.body: The orders their surveyor carried told what the blood elves were for: survey the islands, report back and on no account be caught. They were signed with a single letter, S.

title: Azure Watch
body: Azure Watch is the outpost the Hand of Argus raised in the forest west of the Crystalbrook, within sight of the wrecked Exodar. Exarch Menelaous commands it, and swears that here at last, after ten lifetimes of fleeing the Burning Legion, the draenei will stop running and make their stand. Reports of trouble from every corner of the isle cross his desk, and those that matter go on to Velen.

parts.body: A glowing piece of the Exodar was found inside a sickened nightstalker in the woods to the north, and Menelaous admitted the fault was his people's: reports of crushed crystal in the river had been ignored too long.

title: Stillpine Hold
body: Stillpine Hold is the cave home of the Stillpine furbolgs in the north of the isle. For centuries the tribe lived at peace with the land, until the crystal storm fell from the sky and the wildkin, once their allies, went mad and drove them out with a beast of legend, the Kurken, at their side. Their seer Kurz had foreseen it, and foretold a hero not of their blood who would deliver them.

parts.body: Deep inside the hold lay the answer: a crystal from the Exodar, blood red and dissolving into the cave's water, radiating a sickly aura.
sources: quest 9559 reward text (centuries of peace)

parts.body: With the Kurken slain the hold was saved, and the Stillpine went home. Their visions had shown something stranger still: the power core of the Exodar, and the naaru O'ros.

title: Odesyus' Landing
body: Odesyus' Landing is an Alliance camp on the southern shore, set up by Admiral Odesyus after goblin stowaways stole his compass and charts and forced his ships into port. It gathers an unlikely company: a reformed pirate cook, a dwarf of the Explorers' League, a gnome envoy of High Tinker Mekkatorque, and the night elf Priestess Kyleen Il'dinare, who finds that the newcomers look far too much like the eredar her people remember.

parts.body: Orders rolled in the stolen map, from the Venture Company's Mogul Razdunk, told the goblins to strip-mine the island's crystal wreckage and then seize the admiral's ships. Someone in his camp had sold him out.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Odesyus'_Landing (southern coast, two ships, NPC list)

parts.body: The traitor was the gnome envoy Spark Overgrind, a servant of Kael'thas, who boasted that Velen would soon leave himself open to attack.

title: Wrathscale Point
body: West of Odesyus' Landing lie the remains of an ancient night elf settlement, long abandoned and now overrun by the Wrathscale naga, whose warlord Sriss'tiz keeps to the coastal cave of Tides' Hollow. To Priestess Kyleen these are the lands of her ancestors, and she will not see them fouled by the naga, whose kind she has seen at their worst.

parts.body: A rune-covered tablet carried the warlord's orders: take the rest of the island by force, with reinforcements coming from Nazjatar.

title: Valaar's Berth
body: Valaar's Berth is the dock on Azuremyst's western shore, south of the Exodar, where the ship from Auberdine on the Darkshore coast comes in. For the draenei it is the door to the rest of Kalimdor and to the allies they hoped to find there; for those sailing the other way, it is a first glimpse of the strangers who fell from the sky.
